cards.title: Introduction to NgRx
cards.content:
What is NgRx?

NgRx is a framework for building reactive applications in Angular. It provides state management based on the Redux pattern.

Key concepts: Store (single source of truth), Actions (events that change state), and Reducers (pure functions that handle state transitions).

cards.title: Selectors and Effects
cards.content:
Selectors & Effects

  • Selectors: Pure functions used to derive, slice, or compose pieces of state from the store.
  • Effects: Manage side effects like HTTP requests. They listen for actions, perform async operations, and dispatch new actions with the results.

cards.title: Setup and Boilerplate
cards.content:
Modern NgRx

Modern NgRx provides helper functions to reduce boilerplate:

  • createAction()
  • createReducer()
  • createSelector()

These functions make creating the state management architecture simpler and more type-safe.
